name: Shigeru
source:
Likes: Eating pencil sharpeners, repeating what he hears (he can't speak but can repeat, like parrots).

An animal from the world of demons brought back by [url=/c33071]Miyabi[/url] because his fellow humans laughed at him because he is different (the natural colour of their fur is an immaculate white) and she named him Shigeru. The members of his species are "hairballs" and their bodies are made up of... only hair, nothing else. They are unable to speak but learn and remember the sentences they hear very well.

By empowering him to memorize and repeat what he hears, Miyabi takes the opportunity to learn music that he will sing later. However, its ability to memorize all of them can sometimes be detrimental...

" 'I want you to kiss me while calling me by my real name.' "
